operatingStructure: AI-enabled technical solo founder; no employees assumed

verified.hostingScope: Team-wide subscription, not an additional fee for each website. The model conservatively assigns the full plan cost to this publication.
verified.hostingEvidence: Owner-authorized review of Netlify Usage & billing on November 1, 2026. Personal plan $9/month, 1,000 credits, no enabled team add-ons. Automatic credit recharge was disabled. No billing settings were changed.
verified.domainEvidence: Prior domain-registration receipt recorded a charge of $11.08 and an estimated renewal of $11.08. The model uses that amount as an annual planning allowance; the next renewal charge is not guaranteed.
verified.employeeEvidence: Founder-stated current operating structure: technical solo founder with no employees.
verified.architectureEvidence: Repository review: public pages are generated at build time and served as static files. Ordinary page rendering does not call a paid AI inference API. Private investor authentication uses serverless functions.

notes: AI subscriptions, API budgets, software allowances, page weight, request counts, traffic, and future customer-support usage are editable planning assumptions, not verified bills.

Dedicated AI budget allocates the selected share of a software bill to this business. Existing-tools mode counts only additional AI subscription spending and requires sufficient already-paid capacity. The two views are alternatives, not additive expenses.

Public reader traffic does not consume one AI response per visit. Optional AI support is modeled separately as contacts per thousand visits multiplied by cost per contact; entering a budget does not install a support agent.

Hosting estimates include modeled bandwidth, requests, deployments, compute, and an adjustable non-reader usage allowance. They exclude other projects, rollover of included credits, special features, taxes, and negotiated pricing. Top-ups are rounded to whole packs and unused purchased credits carry into later months.

Higher traffic requires sufficient credits. The current account has automatic recharge disabled; the projection assumes additional credits would be purchased when needed. No plan change or purchase is performed by this calculator.
Founder pay, marketing, professional services, and other costs remain explicit choices. A pre-tax operating surplus before founder compensation is not an audited net profit or a valuation.
